title: Coefficient dual on $X$
statement:
In the Poincare duality conventions of this chapter [def-pod-conventions] (the fixed setting), let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$, with the finite-Tor category of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Work on the small pro-etale site of $X$, with the coefficient-stage tensor product and derived internal Hom of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the tensor–internal-Hom adjunction of [sk-def-sf-operations] (i). Write $\Lambda_X$ for the coefficient unit at that stage [def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology]: the constant finite-level unit, the completed integral unit, or the corresponding rational/common-stage unit.

The *coefficient dual* is

$$
K^\vee=R\mathcal Hom_X\bigl(K,\Lambda_X\bigr),
$$

with the canonical evaluation

$$
\operatorname{ev}_K:K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}K^\vee\longrightarrow\Lambda_X
$$

of the tensor–internal-Hom adjunction. At the integral stage $K^\vee$ lies in $D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ by [cor-coef-integral-internal-hom], applied to $K$ and the coefficient object $\Lambda_X=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,X}\in D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible]; so the integral tensor product above is defined, and at the rational stage (on integral objects) and at the common stage (at the compositum stage) the pair $(K,\Lambda_X)$ lies in the domain of the rational and common-stage internal Hom. Explicitly, $\operatorname{ev}_K$ is the counit of that adjunction (for this $K$) at $\Lambda_X$, or equivalently the inverse image of $\operatorname{id}_{K^\vee}$ under the adjunction bijection

$$
\operatorname{Hom}\bigl(K\otimes^L_{\Lambda_X}K^\vee,\Lambda_X\bigr)
\cong
\operatorname{Hom}\bigl(K^\vee,R\mathcal Hom_X(K,\Lambda_X)\bigr).
$$

split_report.summary: Split the definition into existing notions only: fixed setting, the pro-etale bounded constructible finite-Tor category, the stage-specific coefficient unit and operations, and the tensor–internal-Hom adjunction. Made the specified canonical evaluation explicit as the counit at the unit, equivalently the transpose of the identity. Preserved every hypothesis and the small pro-etale site; no perfectness or preservation assertion is added. No new nodes. The rejected etale attachment is not reused. Maintainer-reader repair: added the well-definedness theorem cor-coef-integral-internal-hom (with the constructibility of the integral unit, lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible), since the integral tensor product and the rational/common-stage internal Hom of def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom are defined only on constructible inputs.
